slice: D5 - small tools, storage, organisation, travel gear and hardware-free gadgets

ideas.name: Gate-Fit Under-Seat Packing System
ideas.concept: Soft-sided sling/under-seat bag plus 3 matched packing cubes sized to the 40x30x20 cm free budget-airline personal item, sold as one set.
ideas.target_customer: Nordic/EU city-break and weekend travellers flying Ryanair/Wizz/easyJet who want to avoid cabin-bag fees.
ideas.problem_solved: Fitting a trip into the free under-seat allowance without gate-sizer fees.
ideas.trend_evidence: Search results (secondary sources) say Ryanair/Wizz/easyJet charge for cabin bags and enforce a 40x30x20 cm under-seat limit, and 2026 roundups tie compression cubes to fee-avoidance hacks. Sources conflict on exact dimensions and give no TikTok view counts, so virality is unverified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Own bag+cube dimension system verified against airline sizers (publish a 'fits-or-refund' test), own pattern/design, registered design, Nordic brand; Amazon generic bags are crowded so lead with the system and fit guarantee.
ideas.est_landed_cost_eur: 9-13 for set at MOQ 300 (sewn goods, no tooling)
ideas.tooling_needed: None (cut-and-sew, sampling only; pattern and trims)

ideas.name: Skadis-Compatible Birch & Steel Accessory Set
ideas.concept: Laser-cut birch and bent-wire holders, hooks and trays that fit IKEA SKADIS pegboards, bundled as a desk starter set.
ideas.target_customer: Desk-setup/home-office and creative hobbyists in SE/DK who already own or buy IKEA SKADIS.
ideas.problem_solved: IKEA's own accessories are limited and generic; owners want better-looking, specific-use holders.
ideas.trend_evidence: YouTube reports 250M+ views of desk-setup videos in H1 2026 and pegboard desks recur in 2026 roundups; IKEA released new SKADIS colours. I did not verify EU-specific sales or how many third-party accessory brands already exist (likely many on Etsy/3D print).
ideas.defensibility_angle: Cohesive design language and curated bundles; registered design on holder geometry; check IKEA trademark use carefully (describe as 'compatible with', never use branding).
ideas.tooling_needed: None (laser cutting/wire bending use dies at most under EUR 500)

ideas.name: Nordic Pantry & Drawer Label Refill System
ideas.concept: Reusable Swedish/Danish-language label sets (waterproof, wipe-clean) with a refillable sheet subscription for pantry, freezer, spice and drawer organisation.
ideas.target_customer: Home-organisation fans in SE/DK, renters and families, mostly women 25-45 following reset/pantry content.
ideas.problem_solved: English-only or generic label sets; people want native-language, consistent, repositionable labels.
ideas.trend_evidence: A seller guide claims 233% YoY growth for TikTok Shop home organisation incl. shelf labels (vendor-sourced, treat cautiously); a 2026 trend piece lists timed resets and pantry goals as organisation trends. No SE/DK data verified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Localised Nordic vocabularies, design and refill-pack recurring purchase; low copyability barrier is the weak point so brand and bundle must carry it.

ideas.name: Felt Modular Drawer Organiser Set (Nordic sizes)
ideas.concept: Recycled-PET felt folding trays in sizes matched to standard Nordic/IKEA drawer widths, sold as measured kits.
ideas.target_customer: Design-minded apartment dwellers SE/DK/DE, gift buyers.
ideas.problem_solved: Generic plastic organisers do not fit drawers and look cheap.
ideas.trend_evidence: Drawer-organiser content features in 2026 TikTok-organisation roundups and market-trend pages, but the category is big and busy; no verified EU acceleration data.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Fit-to-drawer sizing system and design; otherwise weak, copyable by Amazon sellers.

ideas.name: Design Luggage Tag with Tracker Pocket
ideas.concept: Vegetable-tanned or recycled-material luggage tag with a concealed pocket for a standard tracker (AirTag/Tile-agnostic), no battery supplied.
ideas.problem_solved: Trackers need a holder that looks good and survives baggage handling.
ideas.trend_evidence: Reviews describe AirTag-style luggage tags as a viral travel hack and Accio (a sourcing vendor) cites sustained AirTag-holder search interest peaking July 2025; no verified TikTok view counts. Established brands (Speck, Target own-label) already sell these.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Material/design brand play only; weak defensibility and crowded, so best as an add-on to idea 1 not a standalone launch.
